mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.status IN ('ABORTED', 'EXPIRED') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_cancellations AS cancellation WHERE cancellation.payment_id = payment.id AND cancellation.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'FAILED') AND NOT ( cancellation.request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' AND cancellation.status = 'FAILED' AND cancellation.failure_code = 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED' ) )

SELECT pickup_order.id AS order_id, pickup_order.pickup_at, pickup_order.order_number, CONCAT( COALESCE( ( SELECT order_item.product_name FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = pickup_order.id ORDER BY order_item.id LIMIT 1 ), '주문 상품 없음' ), CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = pickup_order.id ) > 1 THEN CONCAT( ' 외 ', ( SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = pickup_order.id ), '개' ) ELSE '' END ) AS product_name, pickup_order.status FROM orders AS pickup_order WHERE pickup_order.pickup_at >= #{start} AND pickup_order.pickup_at < #{end} AND pickup_order.status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' ORDER BY pickup_order.pickup_at, pickup_order.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT recent_order.id AS order_id, recent_order.order_number, CONCAT( COALESCE( ( SELECT order_item.product_name FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = recent_order.id ORDER BY order_item.id LIMIT 1 ), '주문 상품 없음' ), CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = recent_order.id ) > 1 THEN CONCAT( ' 외 ', ( SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = recent_order.id ), '개' ) ELSE '' END ) AS product_name, recent_order.status, recent_order.final_amount FROM orders AS recent_order ORDER BY recent_order.created_at DESC, recent_order.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
